title: Oct 28 · Worn, faceless · Old Navy Long-Sleeve Waffle

product.name: Old Navy Long-Sleeve Waffle Crew - Heritage Green

script.text: Old Navy finally put their long-sleeve crew neck on their TikTok shop.
This is their Long-Sleeve Waffle Crew, so you're definitely going to get that soft waffle knit with this one.
I'm rocking the heritage green here, but they also come in dark walnut.
I'm 6'2 185, rocking a size M in this one for a more fitted look.
So I'd definitely recommend going true to size, but their most popular sizes are going quick.
So if you're seeing this in time and your size is still available, I definitely wouldn't miss out on this one.

shop.creator: 9d770c
shop.notes:
Bedroom, waist-down. 1 take, near-identical. Wear it, film waist-down, say your height and size.
Lighting: Key (circle) in front at 45°, center at chest height, tilted down toward the waist, ~70%. Fill panel 1 on the other side, ~35%, so the fabric shows. Fill panel 2 behind and to the side, low, as a rim light that outlines the fit against the background. Never a window behind you. Tape a mark on the floor so every take matches.
